title: Explore result
description: An Explore run's final response: one JSON document of this schema, the result text of the Forager contract's dev.qory.runtime.result event, https://qory.dev/contracts/forager/v1/events/runtime.result.schema.json, which the event's result string holds. The event that counts is the run's last dev.qory.runtime.result, last in the order of the events' sequence, or the only one when the run emits one. When that event's is_error is true, or it carries no result, or the run emits no dev.qory.runtime.result, the run has no explore result, and the control plane treats it as a run that returned no result. The control plane reads the document as untrusted input, at most 128 KiB, counted as the UTF-8 bytes of the event's result string once the event is read: the document's text as that string carries it, not the escaped form in which the event's JSON writes it. It refuses a document that breaks this schema or is larger. message and question are Markdown, title and explanation are plain text, and no text value is ever followed as an instruction. Every object refuses a member this schema does not define. With the verdict understood, message is required and questions is absent; with the verdict not_understood, questions is required and message is absent. The document is a step's result, not a request, and is not signed.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

verdict.description: understood, when the agent understood the work item; not_understood, when it did not and asks its questions.

message.description: The agent's proposal, as Markdown text.

questions.description: What the agent needs answered before it can say how to do the work, 1 to 20 questions.

question.description: The question, as Markdown: text, lists and code blocks.

options.description: The answers the run offers, 0 to 10: empty when the run offers no option and the person writes the answer.

title.description: The option's title, plain text, 1 to 200 characters.

explanation.description: A short explanation of the option, plain text.

text.description: Text that may span lines: tab, line feed and carriage return are its only control characters, and U+0000 to U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E to U+001F, U+007F and U+0080 to U+009F are refused. So are the characters https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/description.schema.json refuses in a prose line, $defs line, beyond control characters: the bidirectional controls, the marks U+061C, U+200E and U+200F, the embeddings and overrides U+202A to U+202E and the isolates U+2066 to U+2069; the separators U+2028 and U+2029; and the format characters U+00AD, U+180E, U+200B, U+2060 to U+2064, U+FEFF and U+FFF9 to U+FFFB.

short_text.description: A short text, such as an option's explanation, an answer or a change: 1 to 2000 characters.

message.description: A proposal as Markdown text, at least 1 character. The bound of 128 KiB on the whole result document limits its length.
